scores.reason: Verified: the Reveal Payload button (SecretDetailsView.tsx:89) calls getSecretPayload with no canUser check, although key-manager:secrets:payload is defined and mapped; epic #1133 requires all action-triggering elements gated. Create/Delete and list queries are gated, so the criterion is only partly delivered (precedent table: Low).

updateSecret/addContainerSecret/deleteContainerSecret exist in the router with no client caller, but the PR body lists them as server procedures and unused API surface is not a defect; whether missing Edit/Manage UI is in scope is unclear.

usePermissions.ts:6 defines secrets:update/containers:update/payload keys never checked; unused update keys follow from there being no update UI, and the payload-gating part is already covered by C57.
